question:
This industrial part is left-right symmetric about the vertical centre line of the image, so the two halves should look identical. One side may carry a defect that its mirror counterpart does not have. The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). (A) [0.2322, 0.4660, 0.3809, 0.6147]
(B) [0.4686, 0.8393, 0.6173, 0.9880]
(C) [0.2422, 0.1245, 0.3909, 0.2732]
(D) The two halves match; no defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
